note: Lafayette (60-ft strip with 20in W.P. and 12in sewer) comes in from the NE and ends on Ludlow, which bends here: one leg runs S/SSE (street railway, 8in W.P.), the other runs W/NW off the left edge of the drawn area at x=0. Centre taken where Lafayette's centreline (between north edge ~(100,557)-(400,440) and lot-40 block edge ~(145,622)-(400,540)) meets Ludlow's centreline (west edge ~(40,665)-(75,750), east edge ~(140,620)-(185,750)); pipe lines cross at ~(55,607). Junction itself is visible, but the NW leg of Ludlow is cut by the plate/map edge only ~40-75 px west of the centre. Hydrant at ~(65,560), valve dot ~(60,640).

Lafayette Ave. (north edge from block corner ~(4945,3797), south edge from block corner ~(4995,3875)) runs ENE and ends on Ludlow Ave., which bends here from its NW leg to its SSE leg. Point = Lafayette centreline meeting the Ludlow centreline at the bend. The dash-dot 'Proposed Ludlow / City of Cincinnati' line to the SW is not a street.

Groub St. runs N-S between blocks 70 and 71 and reaches Ralston at ~(378,3411). Its line continues north past Ralston only as a narrow open gap (~7 m) between a small triangular lot (dims 40', 47.45', 44.21', apex ~(318,3305)) and the west face of block 67, opening into Geringer St.; '3620' is written in that gap. I took where the Groub centreline extended through that gap meets the Geringer centreline (Geringer is a straight NE-SW street, centre through ~(335,3218) and ~(191,3497)). Alternative reading: Groub ends at Ralston (T at ~(378,3411)) and only reaches Geringer via Ralston, whose junction with Geringer is ~(215,3451) at the north tip of block 70.

Same junction as on 37R (overlap; 37L x is about 37R x + 5633, y about equal around here). Groub's line continues north of Ralston only as a narrow gap between a small triangular lot (apex ~(5951,3305)) and block 67's west face, opening into Geringer; point is where that line meets the Geringer centreline. Geringer is printed 'GERINGER' at ~(5700,3780) on this plate. Alternative reading: Groub ends at Ralston (~(6012,3411)) and reaches Geringer only via Ralston (~(5848,3451)).

Ralston runs WSW from Spring Grove; its south edge is the north line of block 70 (~(225,3500)-(357,3467)), its north edge block 67's south line extended past a small triangular lot. Its centreline meets Geringer's straight NE-SW centreline at the north tip of block 70. Directly opposite on the west side of Geringer an unnamed 60' street (between blocks 65 and 66, centre ~(170,3453) at Geringer's west edge) leaves toward the NW/canal, so physically a four-way crossing; only Ralston is named. The open area to the NE (triangle lot, Groub's mouth) is part of the same plaza.

Same junction as on 37R (overlap; 37L x is about 37R x + 5633). Ralston centreline meets Geringer centreline at the north tip of block 70 (block corner ~(5860,3500)); an unnamed 60' street leaves westward/NW opposite, between blocks 65 and 66 (60' label at ~(5711,3400)).

Groub St. (between block 70 east line and block 71 west line, centre ~(402,3500)) ends on Ralston (north edge = block 67 south line, south edge = block 71 north line, centre ~(357,3416)). North of the point is open plaza/the narrow gap toward Geringer, not a continuation of Groub at full width. Ralston's own printed suffix is not next to the label here.
